info.name: MLS API Collection
info.description: Postman collection for MLS (My Learning System) Spring Boot Application

request.description:
Register a new user account

**Request Body:**
- `username` (required, 3-50 characters): Unique username
- `email` (required, valid email): User email address
- `password` (required, min 6 characters): User password
- `phoneNumber` (optional): Phone number
- `fullName` (optional): Full name
- `avatarUrl` (optional): Profile avatar URL
- `address` (optional): Residential address
- `city` (optional): City name
- `bio` (optional): User biography

**Response (201 Created):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "User berhasil didaftarkan",
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "username": "johndoe",
    "email": "john.doe@example.com",
    "phoneNumber": "+628123456789",
    "role": "USER",
    "isActive": true,
    "createdAt": "2024-01-15T10:30:00",
    "updatedAt": null,
    "account": {
      "id": 1,
      "fullName": "John Doe",
      "avatarUrl": "https://example.com/avatar.jpg",
      "address": "Jl. Sudirman No. 1",
      "city": "Jakarta",
      "postalCode": null,
      "bio": "Software Developer",
      "createdAt": "2024-01-15T10:30:00",
      "updatedAt": null
    }
  }
}
```
